accuracyFlags.claim: Section 07: 'Two-wheel drive vehicles are limited to the sealed roads, which still reach Ubirr, Nourlangie and Gunlom.'
accuracyFlags.correct: Gunlom is down an unsealed road (Parks Australia lists it with Two Mile Hole, Kubara, Yurmikmik); some hire companies bar 2WDs and 'you may still need a 4WD'. Not on the 4WD-only list, so a private 2WD can use it in the dry. Suggested: 'Sealed roads reach Ubirr and Nourlangie. Gunlom is down a long unsealed road that many hire agreements exclude for 2WDs, so check the Kakadu road report and your rental terms.' Do not print a ~37-40 km figure as official. Gunlom Road upgrade in planning 2026/27.
accuracyFlags.fix: Gunlom is NOT on sealed road: unsealed access, many hire 2WDs excluded; check road report and rental terms (kakadu.gov.au)

accuracyFlags.claim: Section 08: 'there is no supermarket in Kakadu' and Keep-in-mind 'No supermarket inside Kakadu'.
accuracyFlags.correct: Jabiru, inside Kakadu, has a supermarket and service station; Cooinda's store sells fuel and groceries. Suggested: 'Do a big shop in Darwin. Jabiru has the only supermarket in the park, and roadhouse prices reflect the distance.'
accuracyFlags.fix: Jabiru (inside Kakadu) HAS a supermarket; Cooinda sells fuel and groceries
